evidenceStates.label: SOURCE CONFIRMED
evidenceStates.desc: Primary technical source verifies the hardware or implementation.

evidenceStates.label: BUILT
evidenceStates.desc: Software artifact reproducibly compiled or packaged.

evidenceStates.label: PROBED
evidenceStates.desc: The exact physical device reported the expected hardware.

evidenceStates.label: FLASHED
evidenceStates.desc: The exact artifact was written to the device.

evidenceStates.label: INTEGRATED
evidenceStates.desc: The capability operated through the BLACKWAVE system boundary.

evidenceStates.label: REGRESSION VERIFIED
evidenceStates.desc: Later changes preserve the previously verified capability.

evidenceStates.label: BLOCKED
evidenceStates.desc: A required evidence step cannot yet be completed.
